description: Class representing a single formatted part of a table style.

Clear.description: Removes all the explicit formatting from the table style element, keeping its stripe size.

GetFillColor.description: Returns the background color of the table style element. Returns 'No Fill' when no fill is set.

GetFont.description: Returns the font of the table style element. Its Size, Name, Subscript and Superscript cannot be set.

GetHasFormat.description: Returns whether the table style element carries any explicit formatting.

GetStripeSize.description: Returns the number of rows or columns in one stripe of the table style element.

SetBorders.description: Sets the border style for the table style element. Only the Left, Top, Bottom, Right, InsideHorizontal and InsideVertical positions are supported.

params.description: Specifies the line style used to form the cell border.
params.name: lineStyle

params.description: The color object which specifies the color to be set to the cell border.
params.name: color

SetBorders.signature: SetBorders(bordersIndex: BordersIndex, lineStyle: LineStyle, color: ApiColor): void

SetFillColor.description: Sets the background color of the table style element. Pass null or 'No Fill' to remove the fill.

params.description: The fill color, or null / 'No Fill' to remove the fill.
params.name: color

SetStripeSize.description: Sets the number of rows or columns in one stripe of the table style element. It affects the row and column stripe elements.
